input.text:
tok 1.0 "Deregistration"

pool org "Metering"
  lane mpoo "MPOO"
    start begin "Deregistration needed"
    task dereg "Deregister at the GO"
    task confirm "Confirm the continuation"
  lane go "GO"
    task verify "Verify the deregistration"
    xor ok "Deregistration confirmed?"
    task reject "Reject the deregistration"
    task prelim "Preliminarily confirm the deregistration"
    task prepare "Prepare the readmission of the measuring point"
    xor oblige "Oblige MPOO to continue?"
    task bind "Oblige the MPOO to continue the operations"
    xor merge
    task equip "Perform the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes"
    task assign "Assign the GO as MPO"
    and split
    task informmpoo "Inform the MPOO about the end and the beginning of the assignment"
    task informmspo "Inform the MSPO about the assignment of the GO"
    task informsp "Inform the SP about the assignment of the GO"
    and join
    end done "Assignment completed"
    end rejected "Deregistration rejected"

flow begin -> dereg -> verify -> ok
flow ok -> reject "no"
flow ok -> prelim "yes"
flow reject -> rejected
flow prelim -> prepare -> oblige
flow oblige -> bind "yes"
flow oblige -> merge "no"
flow bind -> confirm -> merge
flow merge -> equip -> assign -> split
flow split -> informmpoo -> join
flow split -> informmspo -> join
flow split -> informsp -> join
flow join -> done
